'''Christopher Knight''' (forums handle '''cedron'''; GEMP handle '''Cedron''')<ref name="cc1" /> is a [[Players Committee]] volunteer on the Graphics team under [[Production Advocate]] [[Mike Kessling]].<ref name="chart">PC Organization Chart, [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback Machine capture of 10 October 2026] of [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (PDF creation date 6 May 2024).</ref>

== Community card ==
Christopher Knight appears on the community card ''Christopher K'' (2024 Advocate Award), which lists his GEMP handle Cedron.<ref name="cc1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Communitycards/Series%20One/Christopher%20K.jpg ''Christopher K'' (2024 Advocate Award)], [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Communitycard.html SWCCG Community Awards], res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012180213/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Communitycards/Series%20One/Christopher%20K.jpg Internet Archive]</ref>

== Card credits ==
Christopher Knight is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the original concept of two cards.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards are in [[Virtual Set 24]], released 30 December 2024.
Two cards in all (Concept: 2).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The tables give each card, its side, its set and the set's release date, the card it was made from (the title in the strip along the card's bottom edge, when it differs), and the credit exactly as printed. The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Christopher Knight|Christopher Knight]] on the Card Credits page.<ref name="cardcredits">[[Card Credits]], SWCCG Wiki (generated from card_labels.json at commit 0bc4377d9).</ref>
